signals.text: Extend the existing wordcount PATH command to always report both word count and character count.
Count characters as Unicode code points (café counts as 4), excluding whitespace including spaces, tabs and newlines.
Print a single labeled line in this exact format: words: <N> characters: <M>.
Keep the command name wordcount and its PATH argument, and add no flags.

DISCOVER.core_issue: Users want a non-whitespace character count alongside the word count when inspecting a UTF-8 file.
DISCOVER.impact_value: Makes both measures available in one command, with character counts reflecting Unicode code points rather than UTF-8 bytes.
DISCOVER.discovery_method: Review of the requested extension and the human's clarification answers against the existing approved word-count specification.
DISCOVER.pattern_dependencies: The requested character count and combined output concern one extension of the existing word-count command; no dependencies between separate patterns were identified.

pattern_narratives.applies_to: Users inspecting readable UTF-8 files with wordcount PATH.
pattern_narratives.confidence: High, based on the explicit intent and clarification answers.
pattern_narratives.current_state: The approved command reports only the integer word count; it does not report a character count.

DISCOVER.Should whitespace characters, including: No. Exclude whitespace characters, including spaces, tabs and newlines.
DISCOVER.Should `wordcount PATH` always print bot: Always print both counts. Keep wordcount PATH; no new flags.
DISCOVER.If both counts are printed, what exact s: Single line, exactly like this example: words: 3 characters: 14 (word count first, then character count, both labeled).
